metric_definitions.invariant_violations: innermost node not containing the cursor, or a parent not strictly containing its child
metric_definitions.innermost_in_ra: positions whose innermost ridx range occurs anywhere in the rust-analyzer chain
metric_definitions.innermost_eq_ra_first_nonempty: positions whose innermost ridx range equals rust-analyzer's first non-empty node
metric_definitions.all_in_ra: positions where every ridx range occurs in the rust-analyzer chain
metric_definitions.nodes_in_ra: ridx ranges occurring in the rust-analyzer chain, over all positions
metric_definitions.fn_item_start: ridx fn item nodes (parent of a `{` body node with the same end): found in rust-analyzer as is, found only with the start moved to the first fn/pub/... keyword line, or neither
metric_definitions.latency: per-request round trip measured by the client, cold = first ask, warm = second ask of the same position
